An '''Air Pulse ''ter'angreal''''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' enhancing the abilities of a channeler's offensive attacks that use weaves of [[Five Powers|Air]]. It is only known to have survived the [[Breaking of the World]] in the [[Mirror World]] inhabited by [[Elayna]] Sedai.

== Appearance ==
The Fireball ''ter'angreal'' appears as a figurine with blue skin, whose face is making an expression that appears as if it is about to blow a large amount of air.

==Use==
The Air Pulse ''ter'angreal'' is somewhat like an ''[[angreal]]'', but has a specific purpose of enhancing offensive weaves of Air in particular. This is useful for channelers relatively weak in the [[One Power]], or weak in Air in particular, who can thus use the ''ter'angreal'' to enhance their blasts of Air in combat. 

Unlike certain offensive ''ter'angreal'', the Air Pulse ''ter'angreal'' is considerably reliable, and it can be used an unlimited amount of times without its use triggering a dormant period.<ref name="VideoGame">''[[The Wheel of Time (video game)|The Wheel of Time]]''. Red Eagle Games, 1999.</ref>

==History==
In a Mirror World, a [[novice]] named Elayna took her [[Accepted]] test, and found an Air Pulse ''ter'angreal'' while in the second ring of the [[silver arches]], during her time trapped in a basement of a powerful [[Darkfriend]]. She found this necessary to use in order to destroy several blockades in her escape from the fabricated situation.

Elayna specialized in the use of ''ter'angreal'' as an [[Aes Sedai]], given her relative weakness in the One Power. She set out with an Air Pulse ''ter'angreal'' from the [[White Tower]] storeroom in her quest to stop a plot orchestrated by [[Darkfriend]]s, [[Shadowspawn]], and the [[Black Ajah]].<ref name="VideoGame"/>
